quotes: Except as provided in paragraph (c)(2) of this section and in § 825.801 containing the special hours of service requirement for airline flight crew employees, whether an employee has worked the minimum 1,250 hours of service is determined according to the principles established under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) for determining compensable hours of work.
claim_judgments.rationale: Claim C0000 captures the permission that any accurate accounting of actual hours worked under FLSA principles may be used, but its summary and scope_text omit the explicit governing exceptions introducing paragraph (c)(1) (namely, paragraph (c)(2) for USERRA service and § 825.801 for airline flight crew employees). Furthermore, the summary fails to specify the purpose for which the accounting may be used (determining whether an employee has worked the minimum 1,250 hours of service). Consequently, scope and summary are marked as errors.

quotes: (c)(1) Except as provided in paragraph (c)(2) of this section and in § 825.801 containing the special hours of service requirement for airline flight crew employees, whether an employee has worked the minimum 1,250 hours of service is determined according to the principles established under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) for determining compensable hours of work.
Any accurate accounting of actual hours worked under FLSA's principles may be used.
unit_judgments.rationale: Unit U0000 is only partially covered by C0000 because C0000's explicit meaning fields (summary and scope_text) omit the governing exceptions for paragraph (c)(2) and § 825.801, and the summary omits the purpose of establishing the 1,250 hours of service threshold.
